# NeuromorphicBrainDecoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of spiking neural networks to infer mental states or visual percepts from neuroimaging data in a hardware-friendly manner. Paves the way for low-power, real-time neural decoders that can be embedded in edge devices for neurofeedback or assistive technologies.
